He succeeds Co-Founder Josh Glade, who will remain a member of Empower's Board of Directors, as the company continues its mission to reach more families and deepen its impact worldwide. ... The transition follows a period of significant growth and accelerating demand for Empower's gold-standard, evidence‑based programs, which now support practices across all 50 U.S. states and more than 35 countries, helping millions of families access programs that deliver measurable outcomes. Glade led the search for his successor, and the executive team unanimously endorsed Guilbault as the right leader to guide the organization through its next phase of growth. Empower Community Care Welcomes JP Guilbault as New CEO to Lead Growth ... ## Empower Community Care Welcomes JP Guilbault as New CEO ... In a significant leadership transition, Empower Community Care has appointed JP Guilbault as its new Chief Executive Officer. This announcement marks a pivotal moment for Empower, a leading organization in the behavioral health sector, renowned for its evidence-based programs and technology solutions that enhance outcomes for diverse populations, including youth and families. This strategic move comes after a decade of substantial achievement under former CEO and co-founder Josh Glade, who will continue his involvement with the organization as a board member. Guilbault's appointment is set against a backdrop of unprecedented growth and a rising demand for the gold-standard behavioral health solutions provided by Empower, which now supports practitioners across all 50 states in the U.S. and over 35 countries worldwide. hits.title: NexPhase Acquires Empower Community Care
hits.snippet: "At Empower, everything we do is rooted in our mission to support vulnerable youth, families, communities, and the systems that care for them," said Josh Glade, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Empower. "We are immensely proud of the outcomes our customers have achieved to date and are energized by the opportunity to deepen that impact even further. The NexPhase team understands the complexity of the behavioral health landscape and shares our commitment to scaling proven, community-based care. Together, we're excited to build on our momentum – helping our partners deliver meaningful change and bringing Empower's services to more individuals, families, and communities who need them."
